integrity: The infinite statement is proved by exact coefficient comparison in the source affine ansatz. A standalone exhaustive checker verifies all unit solutions and every quandle axiom for primes 5, 7, and 11 as a transcription regression.
scientific_limitations: The result classifies only the two equal prime-field fibers with common diagonal parameter 2 and unit matrix entries. It does not classify arbitrary fiber numbers, unequal parameters, nonfields, or isomorphism classes.
title: A missing prime-field family in the three-class multivariate quandle classification
